description: Source code for Android style application refactoring action within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin, including logic for identifying style data, creating processors, and handling refactoring dialogs.

classes.name: AndroidFindStyleApplicationsAction
classes.description: Main class implementing style application refactoring action for Android styles in XML files.

classes.name: MyStyleData
classes.description: Data class holding style information extracted from XML tags.

classes.name: MyTestConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for testing scope during refactoring.

methods.name: isEnabledForTags
methods.description: Checks if the action is enabled for the given XML tags.

methods.name: isMyFile
methods.description: Determines if the given file is an Android resource DOM file.

methods.name: doRefactorForTags
methods.description: Performs refactoring on the provided XML tags.

methods.name: createFindStyleApplicationsProcessor
methods.description: Creates a processor for finding style applications based on style data.

methods.name: resolveStyleRef
methods.description: Resolves a style reference to its XML element.

methods.name: getStyleData
methods.description: Extracts style data from an XML tag.
